newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Reopen of Volga-Baltic canal may miss May 5 target.
newsitem.headline: Reopen of Volga-Baltic canal may miss May 5 target.

text.p: Russia plans to reopen its Volga-Baltic canal system, key to the transport of refined oil products to Western markets, on May 5, but cash shortages may push the date back, a shipping official said on Monday.
The official, quoted by Interfax news agency, said only one billion roubles out of the 16 billion needed for repairs to unspecified hydrotechnical infrastructure had been received.
At least eight billion roubles were needed to get locks in working order, he said.
The system, which closes in winter because of frosts, links the Volga River and the Baltic Sea and is used by barges and tankers.
A significant portion of Russia's heavy fuel oil exports reach St Petersburg for delivery to northwest European markets via the network, which links inland refineries and export ports.
